source.author: H. S. Green
source.edition: Mundane or National Astrology, first edition1911, Alan Leo manual13; Casa Fernando Pessoa copy1-62
source.rights_note: Holding library displays Public Domain Mark1.0. Original page images visually inspected; only original procedural summaries, factual chart data and hashes retained, no scan corpus redistributed.

rules.method: Calculate charts at the Sun entering tropical Aries,Cancer,Libra,Capricorn, corresponding to longitudes0,90,180,270 degrees.
exceptions: Study all four; Aries begins the astrological year rather than January1. Northern/southern seasonal names differ, not the zodiac sequence.

rules.method: Green calculates ingress charts for the latitude/longitude of the capital of the country studied.
exceptions: Software requires explicit site coordinates and labels caller-selected site; it never infers a capital or claims an arbitrary site is nationally representative.

rules.method: Optional old Aries-ASC rule: fixed12,common/mutable6,movable/cardinal3 months.
exceptions: Green says modern evidence is insufficient for close application and all four ingress charts must still be examined. Not a guaranteed duration or automatic expiry date; other ingress charts are not suppressed.

rules.method: Calculate a local chart at the exact longitude conjunction of major planets; consider the sign and the rest of the chart.
exceptions: Selected Jupiter–Saturn only in v1; no new fixed orb,duration,geographic sign rulership or direct planet-pair forecast invented.

rules.method: Angular cusps confer prominence, which is distinct from dignity and is not necessarily favorable.
exceptions: Near-cusp distance has no numerical cutoff specified in these passages; report all angular distances without inventing a Green orb or numeric strength score.

rules.method: Own-sign and exaltation are zodiacal strength; detriment/fall are opposite the respective dignity signs and their expression depends on conditions.
exceptions: Source explicitly gives Sun Leo/Aries and Mars Aries,Scorpio/Capricorn. Full classical-seven lookup is separately identified shared table data; no Lilly sect,bounds,beams,reception or scores imported as Green judgment. Modern outer-planet dignity assignments withheld.

rules.method: Combine planetary topics with house topics while retaining contradictions; a planet does not affect every matter of its house equally.
exceptions: Specific unsourced pair conclusions remain compositional or unsupported, not direct Green delineation. No event probabilities or decisive favorable/adverse aggregate.

conventions.solar_coordinates: Apparent geocentric true ecliptic/equinox of date,DE440s/Skyfield1.54; solve longitude crossing,not maximum declination or civil seasonal date.
conventions.years: UTC calendar-year search1851–2148; four cardinal events in half-open Jan1→next Jan1. Gregorian only.
conventions.time: Existing pinned IANA tzdata2025.2 for display; UTC/TT and modeled UT1 retained. Pre1972 proleptic UTC and uncertain future leap seconds are limitations,not historical time reconstruction.
conventions.houses: Placidus is explicit numerical software realization. Green pp2–4 assumes horoscope construction and does not identify a named system; do not claim a mandatory Green house algorithm or exact reconstruction of every printed cusp. abs(latitude)<60; no polar fallback.
conventions.dignities: Classical-seven domicile/exaltation lookup reused explicitly from verified shared doctrine_tables.json (Lilly1647 p104 factual table); Green pp108–109 supplies interpretive principle. No other Lilly doctrine imported. Uranus/Neptune dignities unsupported.
conventions.aspects: Report nearest major-aspect geometries0,60,90,120,180 with numerical deviations/relative-motion phase; no fixed within-orb classification or Green strength score. Cycles use exact conjunctions only.
conventions.location: Explicit caller site; Green national-capital recommendation shown separately. No capital database/inference.
conventions.optional_duration: Aries only,disabled by default; symbolic3/6/12 months without forecast expiry or suppressing other charts.
conventions.interpretation: Historical British collective vocabulary; direct source components versus explicitly compositional planet-house combination; no geopolitical or financial outcome certainty.
